title: Implementation
description: Executable work that puts a Decision into practice.

id.description: Globally unique slug identifier using lowercase kebab-case.

title.description: A descriptive name for this implementation.

decision.description: ID of the Decision that authorized this implementation.

created.description: ISO 8601 date when this implementation was started.

created_by.description: GitHub username of the contributor responsible for this implementation.

completed.description: ISO 8601 date when this implementation was completed (if applicable).

artifacts.description: Paths or URLs to the concrete outputs of this implementation.

tags.description: Free-form labels for discovery and filtering.
